# Theoretical Questions

1. Suppose that, conditional on age, treatment is randomly assigned:

   $$ (Y_i(1),Y_i(0)) \perp D_i \mid \text{Age}_i $$

   a. How would you estimate the conditional average treatment effect for 30-year-olds?

   b. Suppose you repeat this for every age in your sample (say, ages 25–55). How would you aggregate these estimates to obtain the overall average treatment effect?

2. For each example below, state whether you believe the conditional independence assumption. If not, tell a story about selection bias by giving an example of an unobservable confounder.

   a. A researcher estimates the returns to taking an online coding class and conditions on having a college degree as a proxy for motivation.

   b. A researcher estimates the effect of new apartment construction on home prices and assumes that, conditional on neighborhood average income, apartment construction is randomly assigned.

   c. A researcher estimates the impact of smoking on later-life health outcomes and matches individuals on their average weekly alcohol consumption because smoking is correlated with other risky behavior.



# Coding Exercise

We will use the Almond, Chay, and Lee (2005, QJE) dataset to study the effect of maternal smoking on child birthweight. 
See the class coding lab example for help if needed.

First, load `data/almond_chay_lee.dta` with `haven::read_dta()`. 
The outcome is `bweight` and treatment is `mbsmoke`.
Here is a complete codebook:

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `bweight` | Infant birthweight (grams) |
| `mmarried` | 1 if mother married |
| `mhisp` | 1 if mother Hispanic |
| `fhisp` | 1 if father Hispanic |
| `foreign` | 1 if mother born abroad |
| `alcohol` | 1 if alcohol consumed during pregnancy |
| `deadkids` | Previous births where newborn died |
| `mage` | Mother's age |
| `medu` | Mother's education attainment |
| `fage` | Father's age |
| `fedu` | Father's education attainment |
| `nprenatal` | Number of prenatal care visits |
| `monthslb` | Months since last birth |
| `order` | Order of birth of the infant |
| `msmoke` | Cigarettes smoked during pregnancy |
| `mbsmoke` | 1 if mother smoked |
| `mrace` | 1 if mother is White |
| `frace` | 1 if father is White |
| `prenatal` | Trimester of first prenatal care visit |
| `birthmonth` | Month of birth |
| `lbweight` | 1 if low birthweight baby |
| `fbaby` | 1 if first baby |
| `prenatal1` | 1 if first prenatal visit in first trimester |
